rationale: Although SMTC bounced off the $90.44 session low, that rebound occurred on less than half the volume of the preceding down-candles (16.8k and 21.4k vs 46.7k and 33.5k) and has remained capped below both our $93.06 entry and the $93.42 session VWAP. With the broader market weak (SPY -0.88%) and the original invalidation at $94.85 intact, the bearish thesis remains valid. Also, the currently wide 88.3 bps spread ($92.08 x $92.90) makes closing into the ask inefficient while price is holding below resistance.
